simple.meaning: סָעִיף (çâʻîyph) is a Hebrew word meaning “a fissure (of rocks); also a bough (as subdivided ).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: סָעִיף (H5585) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Judges 15:8, with occurrences in Judges, Isaiah.

definitions.short: a fissure (of rocks); also a bough (as subdivided )
definitions.full: H5585. saiph [ סָעִיף ] noun [masculine] 1 cleft . 2 branch ; — 1 cleft of a crag, construct סֶלַע סְעִיף Judg 15:8 , 11 ; plural construct הַסְּלָעִים וּבִסְעִפֵֿי Isa 2:21 ; הַסּ ׳סְעִיפֵי 57:5 . 2 branches, boughs , plural construct הַמֹּרִיָּה סְעִפֵֿי Isa 17:6 (so divide, Hi Kn Di Dr Sm xxx Du and others) the boughs of the fruit-tree ; suffix סְעִיפֶיהָ 27:10 (of ruined city; compare קְצִירָהּ 27:11 ).
